ADDICTION MEDICINE NOTE   Date: 2026-10-16
38F, outpatient follow-up visit.

S:
Patient returns for scheduled follow-up in the outpatient program. She attends group sessions twice weekly and individual counseling every Monday. Reports cravings are less frequent than at the last visit but still occur most evenings, worse after work. She missed two group sessions in the past month because of transportation problems. Sleep is broken, averaging 5 hours per night. Appetite is fair. She works part-time doing food delivery and says the hours have been hard to keep up with. Symptoms limit her to about 2 hours of activity before she needs to rest; she missed 9 shifts last month. Mother with rheumatoid arthritis. No recent ED visits. Lives with her sister, who drives her to appointments when possible.

O:
BP 122/78, HR 84, RR 14, Temp 98.4 F, SpO2 99% on room air. Weight 142 lb, stable from prior.
General: alert, cooperative, tired appearing.
HEENT: pupils equal and reactive, normal size.
CV: regular rate and rhythm, no murmur.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Skin: no track marks or abscesses.
Psych: linear thought process, good insight, engaged in discussion of goals.
Labs (drawn last week): Hgb 11.6 g/dL, A1c 5.9%. Urine drug screen reviewed with patient.

A/P:
1. Psychoactive substance dependence, active, engaged in outpatient treatment. Continue group and individual counseling. Discussed relapse-prevention plan and evening coping strategies. Provided program crisis line information. Will coordinate with case manager on transportation assistance so she can attend all sessions.
2. Prediabetes, counseled on diet and exercise. Reviewed reducing sugary drinks during delivery shifts. Recheck A1c in 6 months.
3. Anemia, stable on recheck. Continue oral iron daily with vitamin C. Repeat CBC in 3 months.
4. Work and function: discussed impact on her ability to keep a regular schedule. Patient interested in documentation for her coverage renewal; letter to be reviewed at next visit.

Return to clinic in 4 weeks, sooner if needed.
